create_BitsAndBytesConfig: create a BitsAndBytesConfig quantization config with 4-bit or 8-bit quantization parameters
create_BitsAndBytesLinearMethod: create a BitsAndBytesLinearMethod that applies 4-bit or 8-bit quantization to linear layers
create_BitsAndBytesMoEMethod: create a BitsAndBytesMoEMethod that applies quantization to fused MoE layers
test_is_layer_skipped_bnb: test whether a layer prefix should be skipped from bitsandbytes quantization
run_BitsAndBytesLinearMethod_apply: run the apply method of BitsAndBytesLinearMethod to compute quantized matrix multiplication
